sloka: अथ राजा समृद्ध अर्थः सुग्रीवः प्लवगेश्वरः ।उवाच नरशार्दूलम् रामम् परबलार्दनम् ॥४-४०-१॥
transliteration: atha rājā samṛddha arthaḥ sugrīvaḥ plavageśvaraḥ ।uvāca naraśārdūlam rāmam parabalārdanam ॥4-40-1॥

translations.english: Sugriva, lord of monkeys, who was supported by a massive army informed Rama, the tiger among men and a crusher of the enemy army
